BiblicalUsage: To mock is the word for the scorn that answers God: the little children mocked Elisha, saying, Go up, thou bald head; the Chaldeans scoff at kings and deride every strong hold; and Jerusalem is mocked by those near and far because she is infamous.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mockery is the sound of a people who have stopped fearing God, and Scripture records it because God hears it.
